evidence.quote:
remember returns a receipt in
seconds

observations.why: Ratifying a contract that guarantees a fast, reliable receipt appeals to stability of the system and mastery of its design.

evidence.quote: no lost work if the client drops the receipt

observations.why: Framing the design around preventing loss and tolerating client disconnection appeals to security and self-origination of the caller's pace.

evidence.quote:
the agent either polls the run or
gets the reaction piggybacked on a later call

observations.why: Presenting the agent's choice to poll or defer as a design decision appeals to self-origination of cadence and mastery of the system's mechanics.
